models.name: drill
models.source: Original task-authored cordless drill built from boxes; reproducible with make_models.py. No third-party mesh or textures.
models.orientation: z up, lying on its left side; chuck along +x, the drill's top along +y; centred local bounds
models.collision: One convex-hull box collider per part: motor housing, chuck, handle, trigger block and battery; the round chuck shell and the housing stripe are visual only.
models.mass: 0.6 kg set by the task; rigid body, no articulation; the trigger is fixed
